scientific_integrity: Fixed-parameter analytic two-site result; no claim of independent review or external certification. The cited source date is that of the first public arXiv version.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two distinct sites with opposite residuals, known prior mean and unit latent marginal variance, known independent nugget; positive intersite correlation with zero-to-one endpoint limits. High-nugget trichotomy only for noise variance h>=1; the large-contrast exclusion holds for all h>0. Finite lengthscales do not achieve the compactified endpoint extrema. No predictive or general multisite theorem; historical priority not guaranteed.
title: Sharp nugget-induced endpoint switching for a two-site Gaussian-process likelihood
